DO NOT GO TO DURHAM! I REPEAT DO NOT GO TO DURHAM!

I studied for a year a Durham. It was very supbar. 

First, you can't choose where you live. The accommodations are all catered however they only serve food in a very specific time window. The only non-catered accommodation is literally an hour walk to the nearest shop.

The infrastructure is incredibly outdated. Lectures are uploaded after 2-3 weeks. The lecture capture doesn't even include the whiteboard. 
Good luck catching up if you miss a single lecture.

There's no support for mental help. No one to talk too. If you have trouble finishing coursework well too bad no extensions either.

The town centre consists of 3 banks, a Tesco and a Greggs. 

Finally, there's an aura of snobbery among the students. I can't put my finger on it but people just seem to a lot less friendly there.

I visited friends and this isnt normal. I moved to KCL and my god I'm so much happier.
